item.title: Urgent: Crossing of Lymington Road by A41 Finchley Road, 3rd November
item.description:
There is an acute absence of safe pedestrian crossing infrastructure at this busy junction. Although traffic lights control vehicles from Arkwright Road, Lymington Road, and the A41, there is zero pedestrian signal phase or green man to allow pedestrians to cross Lymington Road safely. Hundreds of school children from UCS and nearby schools use this route daily. Pedestrians are forced to judge gaps in fast-moving, multi-directional traffic. Following a recent tragic child fatality on a Highgate school route, this un-signposted crossing represents an immediate, high-severity safety hazard requiring an urgent pedestrian safety assessment and installation of signalised crossing phases. Thank you for prioritising and dealing with this urgent and life-threatening issue promptly.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Finchley Road, South Hampstead, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
